entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0100(0000)]! Oh man, it’s been
a
long
time![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0060_brother_01

entries.text: Thanks so much for coming![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0060_brother_02

entries.text: Sorry that I couldn’t come meet you at the bus\nstop. Things have been crazy at home...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0060_brother_03

entries.text: We had it all in hand!
entries.label: s2_side01_0060_select_01

entries.text: It’s great to see you!
entries.label: s2_side01_0060_select_02

entries.text: Ehehe... Thanks![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0060_brother_04

entries.text: But wait—did you come all by yourself?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0060_brother_05

entries.text: Yo, we’re here too.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0060_friend_01

entries.text:
Hey, nice to meet you! I’m Nemona!\c
You’re Kieran, yeah?\c
[VAR 0x0100(0000)] told us all about you!\c
Like how you’re great at Pokémon battles!
Right?![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0060_rival_01

entries.text: W-well, I don’t know about that, but...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0060_brother_06

entries.text: Dial it back a notch or nine. You’re scaring him.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0060_botan_01

entries.text: I’m Penny. Unlike a certain someone, I’m fine\nwith taking friendships nice and slow.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0060_botan_02

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]And I’m Arven. [VAR 0x0100(0000)]’s
absolute
BEST
friend.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0060_friend_02

entries.text: Staking your claim right from the get-go, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0060_botan_03

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Well, I’m Kieran. I met
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]
when
[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0100)]she
came
here
for
that
school
trip.\c
That’s when we became friends.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0060_brother_07

entries.text:
Um...what else...? Oh, I’m a student at Blueberry
Academy.\c
Er, I mean, I WAS a student there—I’m on a break
right now.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0060_brother_08

entries.text: Whoa, really? I know how that goes. Same thing\nhappened to me![VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0060_botan_04

entries.text: Penny! Don’t go sympathizing with the enemy![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0060_friend_03

entries.text: I thought I could count on you at least to keep\nthis interloper at arm’s length...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0060_friend_04

entries.text: Eh. I just get the feeling we’re pretty alike.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0060_botan_05

entries.text: Wow, your friends seem like a quirky group.\nKinda like you, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0060_brother_09

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Anyways, a friend of [VAR 0x0100(0000)]’s is
a
friend
of
mine![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0060_brother_10

entries.text: I hope you all have a good time staying in\nKitakami![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0060_brother_11

entries.text: Thanks! Now let’s battle![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0060_rival_02

entries.text: That space in front of the community center\nlooked like a good battle spot![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0060_rival_03

entries.text: Vamos! C’mon![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0060_rival_04

entries.text: Does she want me to go with her? Am I supposed\nto go battle her...?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0060_brother_13

entries.text: Yup, go have fun!
entries.label: s2_side01_0060_select_03

entries.text: You’ve got this!
entries.label: s2_side01_0060_select_04

entries.text: Aw man... She’s just as pushy as Sis is...but, like...\ndifferent.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0060_brother_14

entries.text: Oh no. I...I think I might have made a terrible\nmistake.\c\nThis Kieran kid might actually be a good guy![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0060_friend_05

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Of course he is. He’s friends with\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0060_botan_06

entries.text: Y-yeah... Yeah, that’s true.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0060_friend_06

entries.text: Shoot, I must’ve come across like a real jerk.\nMaybe I shoulda toned it down a bit, huh...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0060_friend_npc

entries.text: We introverts know how to recognize one\nanother.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0060_botan_npc

entries.text: You weren’t kidding. Kieran’s great! Lemme see,\nwhich Pokémon should I use for our NEXT battle?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0060_rival_npc
